newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: CRICKET-BOLAND BATTING FIRST AGAINST W.PROVINCE.
newsitem.headline: CRICKET-BOLAND BATTING FIRST AGAINST W.PROVINCE.

text.p: Boland captain Adrian Kuiper won the toss and elected to bat on the opening day of his side's Supersport Series four-day match against Western Province at Newlands on Thursday.
Western Province - Sven Koenig, Desmond Haynes, Jacques Kallis, HD Ackerman, John Commins (captain), Eric Simons, Dave Rundle, Paul Kirsten, Alan Dawson, Meyrick Pringle, Aubrey Martyn, Paul Adams.
Boland - Lloyd Ferreira, Elmar Liebenberg, Wayne Truter, Kenny Jackson, Adrian Kuiper (captain), Matthys Brink, Roger Telemachus, Shaun Ackerman, David Millns, Claude Henderson, Henry Williams.
